message:
Improvements to efficiency of MeasurementLists

Previously, DefaultMeasurementLists always used for PathObjects unless
another list was provided in the constructor.

Since I forgot this myself, and inadvertently made many very
inefficient lists, the default behavior has changed for
PathDetectionObjects - which will use float lists which required.

In order to implement this more generally, a new projected method was
added to PathObject.

author: Pete <pete.bankhead@gmail.com>
message:
Improve show/hide/toggle using key presses

Previously, pressing space or enter with the channel table in focus could toggle a single selected channel - but not all of them.
Now it's possible to show/hide/toggle all selected channels by pressing S/H/T or Enter/Backspace/Space respectively. The reason for two options is that S/H/T is more 'logical' (at least in English...) but requires more keyboard searching - whereas the other keys are typically easy to find quickly, if you know the option is there.

message:
Improve README for better clarity and onboarding

Revamped the README to enhance readability and accessibility for new users and contributors. 

Key improvements include:
- Added badges for Python version, PyPI, tests, and documentation
- Introduced structured sections with emojis for quick navigation
- Included installation steps with virtual environment setup
- Added quick usage example for DQN agent
- Linked documentation, tutorials, and technical report
- Clarified contribution guidelines and added citation format

These changes aim to provide a friendlier and more informative starting point for researchers and developers using Acme.
